text:
maya.dev: Quick sync — where are we on the takt plan for this sprint? Need clear owners for kernel prefetch, KV warmup, and batch backpressure. cc @tj_runtime @sara_pm

tj_runtime: Kernel prefetch PR is in review, waiting on perf tests. I put a note in PR #482. Estimated merge Fri EOD. :eyes:

sara_pm: Can we get a canary after merge? Need to validate tail latencies for small requests (<=64 tokens).

li_engineer: I'll own the canary config and metrics dashboard. Will add the rollout steps and thresholds.

maya.dev: Awesome — li, can you set the prefetch warmup to 1-minute window and KV warmup to 5m? We saw cold starts under 3m last run.

li_engineer: Yep. Also proposing a conservative backpressure threshold at 80% occupancy to avoid queueing spikes. Thoughts?

tj_runtime: 80% seems reasonable for initial rollout. We'll add an override var so Dedicated customers can tweak.

sara_pm: Note dependency: SRE needs the rollout tags for the canary to route logs. @eng-sre FYI.

eng-sre-bot: (automated) Logging config ticket created: INF-721

maya.dev: Blocker: kernel-team needs model-kernel compat test fixed before we can enable continuous batching on canary. @tj_runtime is that tracked?

tj_runtime: Yes — working on test harness. ETA tomorrow AM. If it slips, fallback is to disable continuous batching and keep prefetch only.

li_engineer: I'll draft the rollback playbook and add steps: toggle prefetch, revert kernel, adjust canary weight.

sara_pm: Thanks. Can everyone add CI/perf links in the PR and the rollout doc by EOD? I'll collate for status update.

maya.dev: Perfect. Small ask: please add owner tag (team/owner) in PR titles. Makes automation easier. :thumbsup:

tj_runtime: Will do.

li_engineer: Done — PR #482 title updated.

sara_pm: I'll update the sprint board with the new owners and dependencies.

maya.dev: Closing: followups on infra: INF-721 (logs), PR#482 (kernel prefetch), CANARY-004 (rollout). Ping here if anything slips. Thanks!
